提携・出資・資金調達

relations.text: Uberの年次報告が、Apple App Storeなどのアプリ配信市場に依存していると述べている
relations.text_en: Uber's annual report says its platform relies on open marketplaces including the Apple App Store

source.label: Uber Technologies 10-K
source.quote: Our platform relies on third parties maintaining open marketplaces, including the Apple App Store and Google Play, which make applications available for download.

relations.text: Uberの年次報告が、Google Playなどのアプリ配信市場に依存していると述べている
relations.text_en: Uber's annual report says its platform relies on open marketplaces including Google Play

source.label: Uber Technologies 10-K
source.quote: Our platform relies on third parties maintaining open marketplaces, including the Apple App Store and Google Play, which make applications available for download.

relations.text: UberとGoogle LLCが、Google Maps Master Agreement(2020年7月13日付)を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Uber and Google LLC are parties to a Google Maps Master Agreement dated July 13, 2020

source.label: Uber Technologies 10-K
source.quote: Google Maps Master Agreement, by and between the Registrant and Google LLC, dated July 13, 2020.

relations.text: BaiduのApollo Goが、Uberと多年の戦略提携を結び、自動運転車を数千台規模でUberに展開する
relations.text_en: Baidu's Apollo Go entered into a multi-year strategic partnership with Uber to deploy thousands of autonomous vehicles on the Uber platform

source.label: Baidu 20-F
source.quote: In July 2025, Apollo Go entered into a multi-year strategic partnership with Uber Technologies, Inc. to deploy thousands of Apollo Go’s fully autonomous vehicles on the Uber platform across multiple international markets, with initial deployments planned for Asia and the Middle East.

relations.text: 英国では、Apollo GoがUberなどとロンドンで自動運転車の試験運行を進めている
relations.text_en: In the UK, Apollo Go advanced partnerships with Uber and Lyft to pilot autonomous vehicles in London

source.label: Baidu 20-F
source.quote: In the UK, Apollo Go advanced partnerships with Uber and Lyft to pilot autonomous vehicles in London.

relations.text: Nebiusの年次報告が、2025年10月にAvrideがUberと戦略提携を発表したと述べている
relations.text_en: Nebius's annual report says Avride announced a strategic partnership with Uber in October 2025

source.label: Nebius 20-F
source.quote: In October 2025, Avride announced a strategic partnership with Uber.
source.note: Avride(子会社)単位の関係です。
source.note_en: Relationship is at the Avride subsidiary level.

relations.text: AvrideがUber Eatsと、配送プラットフォーム利用の商用契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Avride signed a commercial agreement with Uber Eats to use its distribution platform

source.label: Nebius 20-F
source.quote: During 2025, Avride onboarded Shake Shack, Wendy’s, and White Castle, and signed commercial agreements with Uber Eats and Grubhub to utilize those distribution platforms.
source.note: Avride(子会社)単位の関係です。
source.note_en: Relationship is at the Avride subsidiary level.

source.quote: to changes in the fair value of our equity securities, including: a $802 million net unrealized loss on our Aurora investment, a $155 million net unrealized loss on our Lucid investment, partially offset by a $409 million net unrealized gain on our Didi investment, a $179 million net unrealized gain on our Waabi investment, and a $145 million
source.note: 投資評価損益の記載のみです。

relations.text: Bank of America, N.A.が管理代理人を務めるクレジット契約(2024年9月26日付)をUberが締結している
relations.text_en: Uber has a credit agreement dated September 26, 2024 with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: Uber Technologies 10-K
source.quote: 10.13 Credit Agreement, dated as of September 26, 2024, by and among the Registrant, as the borrower, the lenders party thereto, the letter of credit issuers party thereto and Bank of America, N.A., as administrative agent.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: Uberの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Uber’s annual report

source.label: Uber Technologies 10-K
source.quote: There are also a number of companies developing and introducing autonomous vehicles and technologies that either are competing with us or may compete with us in the future, including Alphabet (Waymo), Amazon (Zoox), and Tesla.

companies.name: DoorDash
companies.sub: 宅配プラットフォーム

relations.text: Uberの年次報告が、配送事業の競合としてDoorDashを挙げている
relations.text_en: Uber's annual report names DoorDash among competitors in delivery

source.label: Uber Technologies 10-K
source.quote: Our Delivery offering competes with numerous companies in the meal, grocery and other delivery space in various regions for Drivers, consumers, and merchants, including DoorDash, Instacart, Gopuff, Rappi, Delivery Hero, Just Eat Takeaway, and Amazon.

relations.text: DoorDashの年次報告が、競合としてUber Eatsを挙げている
relations.text_en: DoorDash's annual report names Uber Eats among its competitors

source.label: DoorDash 10-K
source.quote: Globally, we compete with other local on-demand delivery companies, including Amazon, Uber Eats, Prosus, Delivery Hero, and other local incumbents.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
